newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: AIB says Riggs bid rumours not true.
newsitem.headline: AIB says Riggs bid rumours not true.

text.p: Allied Irish Banks Plc said on Tuesday that market speculation that it was interested in acquiring U.S. banking group Riggs National Corp was not true.

"All I can say on Riggs is that there is no truth in that rumour," group financial director Kevin Kelly told Reuters after the banking group reported a 13 percent rise in 1996 pre-tax profits to 421 million Irish pounds.
Weekend Irish newspaper reports said U.S. analysts had suggested Riggs, which is based in Washington D.C., could be a possible target for AIB.
AIB announced last month that its U.S. subsidiary, First Maryland Bancorp, was acquiring Pennsylvania bank Dauphin Deposit Corp for $1.36 billion.

Riggs, which has 57 branches in Washingon and neighbouring Virginia where FMB also operates, has recently separated some of its specialised units into a new division, triggering speculation about a possible takeover.
